description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDao class, which manages database operations related to employee memberships in the OrangeHRM system, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee membership records.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling employee membership data operations.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeMembership entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership record by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeMembershipIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing employee membership IDs for a given employee number from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes specified employee memberships for a given employee number.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Searches for employee memberships based on filter parameters, returning matching records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for employee membership search results.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee memberships matching search criteria.
